#!/usr/bin/env bash
# process_video.sh - extract three segments and concatenate into compilation.mp4
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <input_video> <output_dir>" >&2
  exit 1
fi

INPUT="$1"
